purpose: first isolated candidate-1 db.php-to-Rust driver preparation; not full standard-wpdb compatibility or product selection

existing_reference.source: local cached crate archives matched against this unchanged existing lock

candidate_connection_profile.new_option_api: OptsBuilder only; no new URL parameter parsing

existing_public_api_contract.sql: AsQuery for &[u8]/Vec<u8> through Queryable::query_iter -> TextProtocol; no prepared/binary route
existing_public_api_contract.values: TextProtocol Value::NULL => SQL NULL; Value::Bytes => exact non-null bytes; every other Value variant rejected by future codec
existing_public_api_contract.row_slot: Row::as_ref(index)==None means missing/taken slot; never SQL NULL
existing_public_api_contract.columns: QueryResult::columns/columns_ref snapshot before row consumption, including zero-row result; Column::*_ref + flags/character_set/column_length/decimals
existing_public_api_contract.server_version: initial raw handshake bytes are authoritative; parsed tuple and SELECT VERSION are distinct observations
existing_public_api_contract.completion: drain/drop_result or mark unusable, then await Conn::disconnect; no request-to-request pool reuse or Drop-only cleanup claim
existing_public_api_contract.reset: existing Conn::reset is not used in the first physical-disconnect candidate; future reset needs independent session cleanliness proof

future_acceptance_gates: verify original archive/whole-file before hashes, apply in fresh owned copy only, verify all whole-file after hashes
compile pinned patched crate and run the two included pure unit tests without database access
observe actual TLS/non-TLS handshake masks: FOUND_ROWS/MULTI_STATEMENTS/LOCAL_FILES off, independent MULTI_RESULTS preserved
compare native default mysqli same-value UPDATE affected_rows=0 with actual driver count; never correct counts after execution
send non-UTF8 SQL bytes unchanged via COM_QUERY and compare actual request bytes/errors; no UTF8 lossy conversion or regex rejection
compare ordered raw NULL/empty/NUL/0xff/numeric/decimal/bigunsigned rows and zero-row column metadata
preserve raw handshake server-version suffix bytes and actual negotiated capability mask without claiming semantic feature support
request-local transaction/session variables, explicit physical disconnect and fresh next request, no silent retry or unknown-COMMIT success
compare native wpdb prepare/query/public-state/result-modes/charset/error boundaries via owned PHP adapter before declaring any standard-API compatibility
forbidden_shortcuts: Option taken-slot mapped to SQL NULL
native mysqli handle/result exposed to plugins
silent write retry or transport failure reclassified as SQL success

public_api_contract_notes.negotiated_capabilities: standard 32-bit mask of the final serialized HandshakeResponse, stored separately from existing protocol internals; not semantic feature acceptance or MariaDB extended capabilities
public_api_contract_notes.raw_server_version: exact HandshakePacket::server_version_ref bytes excluding the protocol NUL terminator; no tuple reconstruction or SELECT VERSION substitution
